java_locations.role: Resolves the concrete component symbol style at the entity's style-builder snapshot, lets an entity BACK color override that style, and preserves the resulting HColor in Fashion.
Detects HColorGradient at rectangle paint time, asks SvgGraphics for its interned resource id, and paints the rectangle with url(#id).
Interns gradients by ordered color1/color2/policy tuple, assigns source-seeded ids in first-paint order, emits policy-specific endpoints, and reuses duplicates.

rust_locations.role: Resolves component style snapshots and entity overrides correctly, but obtains gradient definitions only from OracleLayout; gradient_fill_or therefore flattens every no-oracle component gradient to its first color.

Already removes unpainted generated resources, orders retained resources by first body reference, compacts gradient suffixes, and rewrites references, allowing a conservative declaration inventory without fixture-shaped ordering logic.

claimed_invariant: Every selected component rectangle gradient remains a typed ordered (color1, color2, policy) paint through style resolution. The SVG backend interns equal tuples, emits policy endpoints, assigns ids in first-paint order across generated resources, and references the resulting id from each painted rectangle. Solid and transparent paints remain unchanged, and unselected declarations never survive into final defs.
causal_divergence: The Cerulean component theme selects #59B6EC-#2FA4E7 for both component entities. Java emits one vertical gradient and both body rectangles reference it. Rust's parser and style cascade retain the same raw value, but render_plantuml_svg supplies no defs on the no-oracle path; gradient_fill_or therefore resolves only #59B6EC. The remaining geometry mismatch belongs to the separately recorded component-document-margin-envelope mechanism.
planned_model_change: Build a no-oracle component gradient inventory from raw skinparam values, style declarations, and entity inline colors before style resolution. Intern normalized color/policy tuples with source-seeded ids, emit matching linearGradient definitions, and pass those defs through the existing gradient_fill_or calls. Let finalize_painted_resources discard unselected declarations and impose Java's first-paint order. Add direct fresh tests for all four policies, duplicate reuse, inline-over-style selection, style snapshots, irrelevant gradient declarations, and source-seed variation.
perturbation_axes: vertical, horizontal, rising-diagonal, and falling-diagonal policies
duplicate tuple reuse versus distinct tuples
theme/style versus legacy skinparam versus inline entity color
renamed labels, changed declaration order, and different source seeds
scope_boundary: This mechanism owns generated SVG gradient resources and fill references for component-diagram entity rectangles. It does not alter component geometry, document margins, SVEK routing, text metrics, non-component use-case rendering, theme parsing, global scaling, comparator behavior, golden data, or fixture eligibility.
acceptance: Cerulean component output contains the same gradient tuple, endpoints, source-seeded id, and body references as Java through render_svg without oracle input; its independent margin mismatch remains visible.
Fresh renamed tests prove all policies, duplicate reuse, inline precedence, snapshot selection, and removal of unpainted inventory entries.
The renderer suite, clippy, full no-oracle ratchet, and frozen mechanical guards pass without family regressions.
An independent checker records a verdict at the exact implementation revision and preserves Java-generated held-outs when the Java oracle is available.
forbidden_approaches: matching Cerulean, theme names, fixture labels, or generated ids
flattening gradients to either stop color
emitting every inventoried declaration into final defs
hard-coding gradient suffixes or declaration order
changing component geometry or document margins in this mechanism
comparator, eligibility, park-list, or golden changes
